about: Nordic brews. Bought with points at the shrine; the blessing takes effect at once. They stack: take each as often as you can pay for. Death takes them all.

rows.label: Troll's Hide Mead
rows.description: Skin like a troll: +100 health each draught, so it takes more hits to go down.

rows.label: Quicksilver Draught
rows.description: Quicksilver in the veins: spells cost 15% less magicka each draught (up to 75%).

rows.label: Twin Strike Ale
rows.description: Twin strike: your spells hit 50% harder each draught.

rows.label: Hearthfire Tonic
rows.description: When you would fall, the hearth calls you back - once for each tonic.

rows.label: Windrunner Brew
rows.description: Run faster and sprint longer with each brew.

rows.label: Hawkeye Tincture
rows.description: Clear sight, clear mind: magicka returns 50% faster each draught.

rows.label: Mammoth Back Porter
rows.description: A mammoth's back: +50 magicka each draught.

rows.label: Frostbite Venom
rows.description: When the dead strike you, frost webs slow everything nearby - wider and colder each draught.

rows.label: Stormcrown Cider
rows.description: Every 12th spell looses a lightning burst around you - sooner and stronger each cider.
